llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed writing-assistance workflow that reads local voice profiles to draft text in a learned style, with no evidence of exfiltration, destructive behavior, or hidden installation behavior.

dimensions.detail: The capabilities fit the stated purpose: it loads voice profile files, selects a register, frames source material, generates prose, applies banned-phrase cleanup, and optionally dispatches review or snapshots when requested or when learning mode is active.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad terms such as voice, generation, and writing, which could activate the skill more often than intended, but the runtime instructions remain centered on voice generation and do not introduce unrelated authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only markdown skill and module files, no executable scripts, no install hooks, and metadata points to a source plugin and declared companion dependencies.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reading $HOME/.claude/voice-profiles and an optional project .voice/override.md is proportionate for a learned-voice generation tool; there is no network upload, credential access, or broad filesystem indexing in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill mentions saving pre-review and post-review snapshots only when learning mode is active, but the snapshot location and retention controls are not defined in these artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the agent reading local voice profile files and optional project voice overrides. Review generated text carefully because the skill may silently rewrite banned phrases or punctuation before showing the final draft, and use only voice profiles you are authorized to imitate.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad triggers are real, but they are an activation-scoping issue rather than evidence of hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Silent auto-fixing is explicitly documented and limited to generated text cleanup such as banned phrases and punctuation; users should know it may change wording before review, but it is aligned with the skill purpose.
